messages.subject: Install instructions for OS X
parts:
Is there any reason the current install instructions recommend a full XCode installation versus just the core build tools available via running "xcode-select --install" at the console? I'm about to have a class of students do their own installs and want to save time where possible. I've never encountered issues with the reduced install, but maybe others have?

Mike

--
Mike Lawrence
Graduate Student
Department of Psychology & Neuroscience
Dalhousie University
